categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Bohui Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the deep processing of fuel oil and specializes in the research, production, and sales of specialty oil products including white oil, base oil, and fuel oil. Its products serve multiple fields such as daily chemicals, textiles, modified materials, energy storage materials, and precision machinery. The company also explores new business models and expands into new product modules and global customer bases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs continuous production processing technology and proprietary innovations, including the Dutch Shell hydroisomerization dewaxing process for environmentally friendly aromatic oils. It emphasizes technological innovation, green manufacturing, and digital factory construction, integrating 5G, industrial internet, AI, big data, and IoT for smart production and management. The company also develops new processes to improve product quality and reduce environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in petrochemical refining, daily chemical products, textiles, rubber, plastics, and emerging energy sectors. The company serves domestic markets primarily in East China, South China, North China, Central China, and Northeast China, with expanding global customer outreach. Major customers are industrial manufacturers requiring high-value specialty oils for various applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in the Ningbo Petrochemical Economic and Technological Development Zone in Zhejiang Province. It has subsidiaries in Singapore and other regions, and sales channels covering East China, South China, North China, Central China, and Northeast China. The company is expanding its overseas market presence through import channels and global customer development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Bohui Chemical Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain, focusing on deep processing of fuel oils and specialty oil product manufacturing. It integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream product sales, establishing a vertically integrated supply chain with enhanced resilience and efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and green transformation, focusing on R&D of new materials, new processes, and product upgrades. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to strengthen core technology development and accelerate digital and intelligent manufacturing. The strategic direction includes expanding high-end specialty oil markets, enhancing product quality, and promoting sustainable, low-carbon production.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of specialty oil products including white oil, base oil, fuel oil, asphalt, and chemical additives. The company also earns income from trade sales and investment returns. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with direct sales constituting 100% of sales revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a specialized leader in the niche market of specialty oils within the petrochemical industry, leveraging its technological innovation and integrated supply chain. It competes with other petrochemical and specialty chemical manufacturers in China, focusing on differentiation through product quality, green manufacturing, and digital transformation. The company maintains strong brand recognition and customer loyalty in its segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.28 billion, a 17.94% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 307 million, reflecting a 51.18% decline. Total assets were RMB 2.14 billion, slightly up by 1.13%. The company experienced operational challenges including a production halt in Q3 but is actively pursuing strategic adjustments and new growth avenues.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Bohui Chemical Technology emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly specialty oils with high added value, catering to diversified and high-end market demands. Its differentiation lies in proprietary technology, continuous innovation, green manufacturing practices, and digital factory capabilities. The company offers tailored solutions for various industrial applications, ensuring product performance and sustainability, thereby creating competitive advantages in specialty oil markets.
